reason: Confirmed: commit ee44efa only touched `blocking.md` and `state.json`; no-tests.md line 13 and testcases.md lines 59 and 64 are unchanged, and `git diff --name-status master -- 'doc/changes/*issue-140-*' 'doc/changes/*issue-165-*' 'doc/changes/*issue-203-*' doc/todo/` still prints `A doc/todo/issue-200-r1-02.md`, so TC-003 fails on the correct change. `git diff --name-status --diff-filter=DMRT master -- doc/todo/` prints nothing, so scoping the `doc/todo/` check to existing files (and saying "every existing file under `doc/todo/`" in line 64) fixes it.

Confirmed: TS-RESPONSIVE-029 (technical.md line 231) says `doc/todo/` is unchanged for issue #200, but the branch adds `doc/todo/issue-200-r1-02.md`, so the technical specification contradicts the change it describes and the TC-003 check built on it. The root cause is the same as R3-01; reword to "the existing files under `doc/todo/`" in the same fix, matching FR-RESPONSIVE-030.
